name: Call of Duty: Black Ops II

locations.note: Die Rise, one of the Zombies maps, has survivors fighting through the ruined, tilting skyscrapers of Shanghai.
In 1986 Mason and Hudson rescue Woods in war-torn Angola and first meet Menendez.
Mason and Woods aid the mujahideen in Afghanistan during the Soviet-Afghan War.
Mason and Woods raid Menendez's cartel compound in Nicaragua in 1986.
During the 1989 US invasion of Panama, Mason and Woods capture Noriega.
In 2025 Section's JSOC team hunts Menendez in Yemen.
In 2025 a drone attack on Los Angeles during a G20 summit is a key mission.
Celerium, 2025: Section's team raids a Myanmar facility to find the rare-earth element behind Menendez's cyberattack.
Fallen Angel, 2025: Section and Harper spy on Menendez in flooded Lahore and find he is after the hacker Karma.
Karma, 2025: Section's team slips into Colossus, a floating city in the Cayman Islands, to rescue the hacker Chloe 'Karma' Lynch and kill Menendez's lieutenant DeFalco.
Judgment Day: Menendez is tracked to Haiti, where Section leads JSOC into the Cordis Die facility and catches him trying to escape.
Shipwreck, an optional Strike Force operation: Section's forces must neutralise an SDC freighter at Singapore's Keppel Terminal.

routes.name: Alex Mason and Frank Woods
routes.note: The 1980s hunt for Menendez runs from a river rescue in Angola through the Afghan mujahideen and the Nicaraguan compound to the trap in invaded Panama.

routes.name: David 'Section' Mason
routes.note: In 2025 Section tracks Menendez from a celerium plant in Myanmar to flooded Lahore, the floating city of Colossus and Socotra in Yemen, defends the President in drone-struck Los Angeles and runs Menendez down in Haiti.
